title: Family pics in Spain!
text: Val was great! Patient with my kids esp. my toddler who wasn’t interested in taking pictures. She had everything planned and ready to go. My family loved the pictures and overall experience. She provided locations to go visit and places to eat. When we come back to Spain, definitely booking again.
author: Z5249TZar

title: Wonderful Experience
text: Val was a wonderful guide and photographer! She was quick to communicate, on time, and I never felt rushed during my photoshoot. The photos were delivered within a few days of the photoshoot and they were excellent! I’m so glad I splurged and have these beautiful pictures to remember my trip by. As a bonus, Val gave excellent restaurant and bakery recommendations
author: Adrienne_R

title: A new travel tradition, started in my favorite city!
text:
I used to live in Barcelona and still visit often. It’s honestly my favorite city in the world. This time, I wanted to try something different than my usual routine. Something fun & memorable, and this photoshoot was the perfect activity for that!

I booked the tour for me & my mom, and it was such a lovely memory for us to share. It took us around 1.5 hours.

Our guide & photographer, Natalia, was so lovely and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. The tour itself was really interesting, and it was such a nice way to experience a city I already know and love. It felt special to make
author: O603ERmaryamh

title: Val told us a lot about...
text: Val told us a lot about the places we visited, recommended a few restaurants to try, and the pictures turned out great.
author: Jocelyn_V

title: Highly recommend- amazing photos and spots!
text:
The photographer was very communicative, prompt, friendly and most importantly took amazing photos!  So much so we ended up purchasing all of the images.  She had some great locations we would never had known about, and made it fun.  Would highly recommend the experience- we were traveling with grandparents and will treasure the photos!
I was nervous at first since we had to skip photos at the front of the Barcelona Cathedral due to a concert set up, but in the end we didn’t even feel like we missed having them.   Thank you!
